name: cloud-audit
why: ANSWER TO LANE QUESTION: BOTH stacked, and neither alone explains the failure. (1) WIRING DEFECT - stale port: the entry points at 31418 (written 2026-09-03 at the stdio->HTTP conversion) but the 2026-09-07 portband migration moved the front to 31118; current authority D:\opt\cyberstrike-mcp\cyberstrike-mcp-lib.ps1:73 'Name = cloud-audit; Port = 31118; Band = Heavy', echoed by generated/tui-mcp-inventory.json and the live TUI config. Old port survives verbatim in backups/portband-20260907-0130/ lib ('Port = 31418') proving the band was retired, not that 31418 belongs to another live hub. Even starting -Profile Heavy would bind 31118 and leave this 31418 entry dead. (2) LAZY-BY-DESIGN gating: cloud-audit is Band='Heavy' ('large Bun RSS'), excluded from Core AND Full profiles; the running supervisor (PID 61728, '-Profile Full -Force', log 2026-09-18T22:56) brings up 31110-31117/31119/31100/31101 but never cloud-audit. Measured now: no listener on 31418 (harness: ConnectionRefused; curl: could not connect; python socket: TimeoutError = firewall drops unbound loopback ports - same no-listener conclusion via 2 probes) and none on 31118. Fallback path also dead: McpHub (:24680, up, HTTP 200 SSE) advertises cloud_audit tools but a functional call to cloud_list_checks returned 'Not connected'. Capability therefore unreachable from every current path; engine is local (D:\opt\cyberstrike-mcp\cloud-audit-mcp.cmd + ~/.local/opt/cloud-audit-mcp). Recommended move (owner decision, not executed - read-only lane): fix url 31418->31118 in the agents.json SSOT so sync propagates to ~/.claude.json and ~/.mcp.json, and keep the front on-demand via '-Profile Heavy' or '-Include cloud-audit' when cloud audits run.

Canonical current value: http://127.0.0.1:31118/mcp (cyberstrike-mcp-lib.ps1:73; generated/tui-mcp-inventory.json; ~/.config/cyberstrike/cyberstrike.json).

Local implementation under D:\opt\cyberstrike-mcp (cloud-audit-mcp.cmd) with ownership pattern '~/.local/opt/cloud-audit-mcp' (lib line 167).
